goal: Rubric analytics dashboard in frontend/src/app/dai-noi/giao-vien/ and backend/routers/classrooms.py
summary: Implemented school-safe rubric analytics dashboard across backend/routers/classrooms.py, backend/schemas.py, frontend/src/lib/api.ts, and frontend/src/app/dai-noi/giao-vien/RubricAnalyticsDashboard.tsx. Computes aggregate descriptive statistics across the 4 core historical reasoning criteria dimensions (S1 Spatial, S2 Temporal, S3 Evidence, S4 Argument) per rubric version (e.g., GDPT_2018_V1, v1.0). Enforces mandatory student privacy suppression via k-anonymity for cohorts < 5 (masking all distributions, means, and individual score metrics when n < 5). Enforces strict negative abuse invariant: descriptive statistics are quarantined from causal assertions; any attempt to claim causal learning gains (claim_causality=true) without an approved controlled study ethics/IRB protocol is rejected with HTTP 422 CANNOT_CLAIM_CAUSAL_LEARNING_GAIN_WITHOUT_CONTROLLED_STUDY.

invariants_enforced.historical_reasoning_criteria_dimensions: Aggregates student scores across the 4 pedagogical dimensions: S1 Spatial (Năng lực Không gian), S2 Temporal (Năng lực Thời gian), S3 Evidence (Năng lực Sử liệu), and S4 Argument (Năng lực Lập luận), computing mean, median, standard deviation, mastery rate (>= 66.7%), and 4-level distribution (M0 Chưa đạt, M1 Cơ bản, M2 Khá, M3 Xuất sắc).
invariants_enforced.k_anonymity_privacy_suppression: When the evaluated student cohort size is less than 5 (n < 5), granular distributions, means, medians, standard deviations, and mastery rates are suppressed (returned as null) to prevent student re-identification in accordance with educational data privacy standards.
invariants_enforced.negative_abuse_causal_claim_quarantine: Descriptive statistics are strictly separated from causal assertions. Calling the endpoint with claim_causality=true without an approved HistoryEthicsProtocol is rejected with HTTP 422 CANNOT_CLAIM_CAUSAL_LEARNING_GAIN_WITHOUT_CONTROLLED_STUDY.
invariants_enforced.horizontal_privilege_escalation_block: Teachers can only access rubric analytics for classrooms they teach (current_user.id == classroom.teacher_id or ADMIN_ROLES). Cross-teacher access attempts strictly return HTTP 403 Forbidden.
invariants_enforced.learner_and_unauthenticated_blocked: Learners/students and guests receive HTTP 403 Forbidden; unauthenticated callers receive HTTP 401 Unauthorized.

changes.description: Added Pydantic schemas: RubricCriterionAnalyticsOut and ClassroomRubricAnalyticsOut.

Implemented _compute_classroom_rubric_analytics and GET /api/v1/classrooms/{classroom_id}/rubric-analytics endpoint with k-anonymity privacy suppression (n < 5), multi-version filtering, and negative abuse guardrail rejecting causal claims without approved controlled study protocol.
Added RubricCriterionAnalytics and ClassroomRubricAnalyticsResponse TypeScript interfaces and fetchClassroomRubricAnalytics API client helper.

Created interactive Rubric Analytics Dashboard component featuring version selector, k-anonymity privacy status indicator, masked privacy view for n < 5, full descriptive analytics view with level distribution bars for n >= 5, pedagogical recommendations, and interactive negative abuse drill button.
Integrated RubricAnalyticsDashboard into the teacher dashboard layout.
Fixed exhaustive-deps warning by adding fetchServerPassport to useEffect dependency array.
Regenerated canonical OpenAPI schema snapshot incorporating ClassroomRubricAnalyticsOut and RubricCriterionAnalyticsOut.

Created 9-test comprehensive test suite verifying 401 unauthenticated, 403 learner, 403 IDOR cross-teacher, 422 negative abuse causal claim rejection, k-anonymity privacy suppression for n < 5, full descriptive analytics for n >= 5, version filtering, admin oversight, and multi-source submission coexistence.

test_details.name: test_unauthenticated_rubric_analytics_returns_401
test_details.assertion: Unauthenticated requests to /rubric-analytics return HTTP 401 Unauthorized.

test_details.name: test_learner_access_to_rubric_analytics_returns_403
test_details.assertion: Learners attempting to view classroom rubric analytics receive HTTP 403 Forbidden.

test_details.name: test_teacher_horizontal_privilege_escalation_blocked_returns_403
test_details.assertion: Teacher A cannot access Classroom B rubric analytics and Teacher B cannot access Classroom A (HTTP 403 Forbidden IDOR defense).

test_details.name: test_negative_abuse_causal_learning_gain_rejected_without_controlled_study_422
test_details.assertion: P2 Negative Abuse Invariant: Asserting causal learning gain claims without an approved controlled study protocol returns HTTP 422 CANNOT_CLAIM_CAUSAL_LEARNING_GAIN_WITHOUT_CONTROLLED_STUDY.

test_details.name: test_privacy_suppression_k_anonymity_when_cohort_less_than_5
test_details.assertion: When cohort size n < 5, granular distributions, means, medians, std_dev, and mastery rates are suppressed (None) with k-anonymity privacy notice.

test_details.name: test_full_descriptive_analytics_when_cohort_at_least_5
test_details.assertion: When cohort size n >= 5, full descriptive metrics (mean, median, std_dev, mastery_rate, distribution) across all 4 criteria are computed.

test_details.name: test_rubric_version_filtering_and_multi_version_inventory
test_details.assertion: Analytics correctly discovers multi-version rubrics and filters student evaluations by active rubric version.

test_details.name: test_admin_cross_classroom_oversight
test_details.assertion: Admins have cross-classroom authorization to inspect rubric analytics across all schools.

test_details.name: test_imperial_and_history_submission_coexistence
test_details.assertion: Aggregates evaluations from both HistoryLessonAssignment submissions and ImperialActivity submissions within the classroom.
